pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a choice? (1 mark)
   A. A gift from a friend
   B. A school rule
   C. A decision to do one thing instead of another
   D. A kind of food

2. Which verse says that God's word is a lamp for our feet? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 12:1
   B. Luke 15:8
   C. Psalm 119:105
   D. Acts 11:26

3. Which of these is a way of respecting family members at home? (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to share
   B. Ignoring instructions
   C. Greeting politely and helping with chores
   D. Shouting at siblings

4. Which verse says that God calls us by name? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Isaiah 43:1
   C. Mark 10:52
   D. Exodus 20:12

5. Which of these is a Gospel? (1 mark)
   A. John
   B. Psalms
   C. Acts
   D. Romans

6. Which of these is the first book of the New Testament? (1 mark)
   A. Acts
   B. Matthew
   C. Genesis
   D. Romans

7. What is the New Testament mainly about? (1 mark)
   A. The creation of the world only
   B. Jesus, His teaching and the early church
   C. The Law of Moses only
   D. The kings of Israel

8. Which of these is kind treatment of a donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Overloading it
   B. Giving it food, water and rest
   C. Beating it
   D. Leaving it hungry

9. How many times did the donkey turn aside or stop before she spoke? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Five
   C. Three
   D. One

10. Which lesson do we learn from Balaam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore God
   B. Curse enemies
   C. Follow money
   D. Obey God and speak only what He says

11. Who was told by an angel that they would have a son called Samson? (1 mark)
   A. Joshua
   B. His parents
   C. Balak
   D. Ruth

12. Which verse says that the fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Proverbs 1:7
   C. John 3:16
   D. Acts 2:38

13. Abram travelled from Haran to Canaan, which lies to the south-west of Haran. In which direction did he travel? (1 mark)
   A. South-west
   B. North
   C. North-east
   D. East

14. Who would come upon Mary so that she could conceive? (1 mark)
   A. An angel
   B. Joseph
   C. Elizabeth
   D. The Holy Spirit

15. What did he ask Jesus for? (1 mark)
   A. Money
   B. Food
   C. A house
   D. Mercy, and to see

16. How many men with leprosy met Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Five
   C. Twelve
   D. Ten

17. Which is a way of thanking God? (1 mark)
   A. Complaining
   B. Ignoring Him
   C. Praying and singing praise
   D. Being rude

18. Leprosy today can be treated with: (1 mark)
   A. Charms
   B. Nothing
   C. Prayer only, without doctors
   D. Medicine

19. If someone keeps hurting you even after you forgive, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Hurt them
   B. Hit back
   C. Tell a trusted adult
   D. Say nothing forever

20. Which statement about forgiveness is true? (1 mark)
   A. Forgiving takes courage
   B. Forgiving is a sign of weakness
   C. Forgiving means telling lies
   D. Forgiving means the wrong was fine

21. What causes joy among the angels of God, according to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. One sinner who repents
   B. A new building
   C. A rich person giving
   D. A large crowd

22. What group did Nicodemus belong to? (1 mark)
   A. The Romans
   B. The shepherds
   C. The Pharisees
   D. The disciples

23. What did Nicodemus bring to prepare Jesus' body for burial? (1 mark)
   A. Myrrh and aloes
   B. Bread
   C. Oil only
   D. Gold

24. Why should we trust God always? (1 mark)
   A. He forgets
   B. He is unknown
   C. He is loving and faithful
   D. He is far

25. If a stranger tries to grab you, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Shout for help and run to a safe place
   B. Go with them
   C. Give them your bag
   D. Stay silent

26. Which of these is a sign of an unsafe secret? (1 mark)
   A. It makes you feel scared or uncomfortable
   B. It makes you happy
   C. It is about a surprise gift
   D. It is about a game

27. Which verse tells us to speak truthfully to our neighbour? (1 mark)
   A. Ephesians 4:25
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Luke 19:5
   D. John 3:16

28. Which chore shows responsibility at home? (1 mark)
   A. Complaining
   B. Washing plates
   C. Hiding
   D. Breaking plates

29. Who does the Bible say we should be like in holiness? (1 mark)
   A. Our teachers
   B. Our friends
   C. God
   D. The king

30. What does it mean to glorify God with our bodies? (1 mark)
   A. To boast
   B. To hurt others
   C. To ignore Him
   D. To honour Him by how we use them

31. What are the two meanings of the word church? (1 mark)
   A. A song and a prayer
   B. The building and the people of God
   C. A market and a school
   D. A river and a hill

32. Which of these is a way of serving God in church? (1 mark)
   A. Talking during prayers
   B. Leaving litter
   C. Breaking chairs
   D. Helping to clean

33. What did the first Christians devote themselves to? (1 mark)
   A. Trading
   B. Teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread and prayer
   C. Fighting
   D. Travel

34. Antioch lies north of Jerusalem. In which direction would you travel from Jerusalem to reach Antioch? (1 mark)
   A. North
   B. East
   C. West
   D. South

35. What does persecution mean? (1 mark)
   A. Being taught
   B. Being praised
   C. Being paid
   D. Being treated badly because of what you believe

36. What does it mean to stand firm in faith? (1 mark)
   A. To hide
   B. To copy others
   C. To give up
   D. To keep believing and doing right under pressure

37. Who taught the disciples the Lord's Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Moses
   B. John
   C. Jesus
   D. Peter

38. Which of these is a person you can pray for? (1 mark)
   A. Only yourself
   B. Only leaders
   C. Your parents
   D. No one

39. Which action shows goodness? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Lying
   C. Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   D. Stealing

40. What does integrity mean when using a phone? (1 mark)
   A. Doing right when nobody is watching
   B. Hiding things
   C. Wasting data
   D. Copying others

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. State three rules for safe use of social media. (3 marks)

42. Give three ways of turning away from sin and living righteously. (3 marks)

43. State three ways of thanking God every day. (3 marks)

44. Explain the lessons that we learn from Matthew 21:12-14. (5 marks)

45. State two lessons from the parable of the lost coin. (2 marks)

46. Give three ways in which God helps us today. (3 marks)

47. Describe how the boy in John 6 shows that small gifts can do great things. (4 marks)

48. Explain how the parable shows God's love for the sinner and how a child can respond. (5 marks)

49. Give two things that make each person unique. (2 marks)

50. Describe how Jesus responded when the disciples sent the children away. (3 marks)

51. Describe how Abram showed obedience when God called him. (4 marks)

52. Describe three steps for making a right decision. (3 marks)

53. Give three steps you can follow to make a right choice. (3 marks)

54. Explain how a child can show faith in God when they or a family member is sick. (5 marks)

55. List six of the twelve disciples. (3 marks)

56. Write the first three books of the New Testament in order. (2 marks)

57. Give three reasons why children should not join ungodly groups. (3 marks)

58. State two ways of glorifying God with our bodies. (2 marks)

59. Give two reasons why we should not take revenge. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — A decision to do one thing instead of another
   A choice means deciding between different actions.

2. C — Psalm 119:105
   Psalm 119:105 compares God's word to a lamp and a light.

3. C — Greeting politely and helping with chores
   Polite words and helpful actions build peace at home.

4. B — Isaiah 43:1
   Isaiah 43:1 says, "I have called you by name."

5. A — John
   The four Gospels are Matthew, Mark, Luke and John.

6. B — Matthew
   Matthew is the first of the four Gospels and of the New Testament.

7. B — Jesus, His teaching and the early church
   The New Testament tells about Jesus and the early church.

8. B — Giving it food, water and rest
   Kindness to animals includes meeting their needs.

9. C — Three
   Balaam struck her three times.

10. D — Obey God and speak only what He says
   Balaam had to speak only God's words.

11. B — His parents
   The angel of the Lord appeared to Samson's parents.

12. B — Proverbs 1:7
   Proverbs 1:7 says this.

13. A — South-west
   Canaan is south-west of Haran, so he travelled south-west.

14. D — The Holy Spirit
   Luke 1:35 says the Holy Spirit would come on her.

15. D — Mercy, and to see
   He asked for mercy and said, "I want to see."

16. D — Ten
   Luke 17:12 says ten men met Him.

17. C — Praying and singing praise
   Praise and prayer express thanks.

18. D — Medicine
   Leprosy can be cured with medicine from health workers.

19. C — Tell a trusted adult
   Forgiveness does not mean staying in danger.

20. A — Forgiving takes courage
   Forgiveness is strong, not weak.

21. A — One sinner who repents
   Luke 15:10 says this.

22. C — The Pharisees
   He was a Pharisee.

23. A — Myrrh and aloes
   John 19:39 says he brought myrrh and aloes.

24. C — He is loving and faithful
   God is reliable.

25. A — Shout for help and run to a safe place
   Shouting and running attract help.

26. A — It makes you feel scared or uncomfortable
   Bad secrets should be told to trusted adults.

27. A — Ephesians 4:25
   Ephesians 4:25 says to put off falsehood.

28. B — Washing plates
   Doing chores shows duty.

29. C — God
   1 Peter 1:16 says to be holy because God is holy.

30. D — To honour Him by how we use them
   We honour God by how we live.

31. B — The building and the people of God
   Church means the building and the community.

32. D — Helping to clean
   Cleaning is service.

33. B — Teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread and prayer
   Acts 2:42.

34. A — North
   To reach a place that lies to the north, you travel north.

35. D — Being treated badly because of what you believe
   Persecution is unfair treatment for faith.

36. D — To keep believing and doing right under pressure
   Standing firm means not giving in.

37. C — Jesus
   Jesus taught it when asked.

38. C — Your parents
   We pray for parents, friends and others.

39. C — Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   Goodness is doing what is right.

40. A — Doing right when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty in private.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ask permission, do not chat with strangers, do not share personal details, be kind, limit time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say sorry to God; be honest; be kind; obey parents; pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pray, sing songs of praise, worship at church, use His gifts well, write a thank-you note.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: The house of God is holy; it is for prayer; we must not misuse it or cheat others; Jesus cares about what happens there; it is a place of healing and help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson up to 5.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Every person is precious to God; God searches for the lost; heaven rejoices when someone repents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: He gives courage, wisdom, the power to forgive, healing and protection, and talents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: The boy shared five loaves and two fish. Jesus used them to feed a large crowd. This shows that a small gift given willingly can help many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy sharing, 1 for the food, 1 for Jesus feeding many, 1 for the lesson.

48. (5 marks)
   Answer: God searches for lost people like the woman for her coin. He is happy when a person repents. A child can respond by saying sorry to God, turning away from wrong, living a righteous life, and caring for others who go astray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's search, 1 for God's joy, 1 for saying sorry, 1 for righteous living, 1 for caring for others.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Fingerprints, voice, face, talents, likes and dislikes. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid answer.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: He told them to let the children come, said the kingdom belongs to them, and blessed them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: He left his country, his people and his father's household. He went to a land he did not know. He took his wife, nephew and belongings. He was seventy-five years old.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stop and think, ask if it pleases God, pray, ask advice, choose the right thing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stop and think; ask if it agrees with God's word; think about who is helped or hurt; pray; ask a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 3.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: Pray, believe that God cares, ask trusted adults, go to a clinic or hospital for treatment, thank God for help, and continue to trust. Faith does not mean ignoring doctors.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for prayer, 1 for belief in God's care, 1 for seeking treatment, 1 for thanks, 1 for continuing to trust.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Peter, Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot, Judas Iscariot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each two correct names up to 3 marks.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct in order, 2 marks for all three correct.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: They lead to wrong; they can harm us; they pull us from God and family; they ask for secrets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep clean and healthy, speak kindly, avoid harmful things, use hands to help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: It starts a cycle of hurt; it gets us in trouble; it breaks friendships; it displeases God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.
